about: THE one list of AI Audio components and control-panel tools. Read by setup\install.ps1
(the Components window: add, repair, remove) and scripts\panel_core.ps1 (the control panel,
which shows a tool only when the files under its 'needs' exist). All paths are relative
to the kit folder. Keep this file ASCII-only.
components[]: key, name, size, desc are shown in the Components window.
remove      folders deleted when the component is removed
keep        the user's own work inside those folders: NEVER deleted
models      downloaded AI models: deleted too unless the user keeps models; a path that
another still-installed component also lists is left alone
locks       package lists in setup\locks, used to trim the package cache afterwards
also_stop   panel tools to stop first, besides the tools that belong to the component
remove_note shown before removing: what else stops working
The install steps themselves are code: the Install-<key> functions in setup\install.ps1.
min_gb      graphics memory the component needs to be worth installing (0 = runs without a
graphics card). Below that it is listed but unticked, with a note.
presets: named picks offered as buttons in the Components window (Select all and Select none
are always there). 'recommended' is the kit author's own line-up: edit it freely.
tools[]: one control-panel row each. kind: web = browser app with a port, app = desktop
window, watch = drop-folder tool, files = drop files on it. bat is in launchers\.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.desc: The author's own line-up: everything except Abogen, whose job Narrate also does.

components.name: Core
components.desc: The folder layout, private Python (nothing system-wide), the control panel and Stop everything. Always installed.

components.name: Transcribe
components.desc: Audio or video to text and subtitles, split by speaker.
components.remove_note: The piano checker (scripts\piano_check.py) runs on Transcribe's engine and stops working too.

components.name: Narrate
components.desc: Documents read aloud (the wise old narrator, or preset voices) with subtitles and an optional video.

components.name: Abogen audiobooks
components.desc: Desktop app: whole books to audiobooks with chapters and subtitles.

components.name: ACE-Step music
components.desc: Songs, covers and restyles from a text description. Opens in your browser.

components.name: Hum to track
components.desc: Hum, sing or beatbox a part; get an instrument playing it (MIDI + audio).

components.name: Stem separation
components.desc: Split songs into vocals and instrumental, or vocals, drums, bass and other.

components.name: Applio voice changer
components.desc: Train a voice model, then re-voice your own performance. Opens in your browser.
components.remove_note: Voice models you trained (tools\Applio\logs) are kept.

components.name: ComfyUI voices
components.desc: Voice cloning, voice conversion and subtitle narration (ChatterBox, VibeVoice). Browser app.
components.remove_note: Narrate's cloned and designed voices (such as the wise old narrator) need this. Without it Narrate uses its built-in preset voices.

tools.name: ACE-Step music (best sound)
tools.desc: Songs, covers and restyles, best sound. Opens in your browser.

tools.name: ACE-Step music (fast)
tools.desc: The same app with the smaller model, for quick ideas.

tools.name: ComfyUI voices
tools.desc: Voice cloning, voice conversion and subtitle narration.

tools.name: Applio voice changer
